rotation: Same three sessions fixed to Tue / Wed / Fri so load progression stays readable week to week.
note: Fifth 0 of 3 week. Nothing logged since 09-16, thirty-two days. Three levers have now been pulled and none of them moved anything: shorter sessions, Monday to Tuesday, then one anchor lift per day. That is enough evidence to say the program was never the constraint, so this week changes as little as possible and only in the direction of less. Seven working lifts across three days, the smallest week programmed yet. Hip thrust comes off Wednesday after five weeks of being programmed and never run; glute bridge takes the slot, which is the same movement off the floor with no bench to find and no barbell to load. Walking lunge drops off Friday to a substitution under leg press, so Friday is two lifts. The anchors are unchanged: lat pulldown Tuesday, overhead press Wednesday, incline press Friday, and the anchor alone still counts as the session. The success condition for this week is one logged session, not three. Loads carry forward for the fifth time because nothing was logged to progress against. Straight sets, no supersets. A day that did not happen is worth logging as a skip, empty exercises and feel 'skipped', so the calendar stops guessing.

progression.rule: Double progression driven by the average RPE of the logged sets, matching the suggester already running in workout.html.
table: avg RPE 7.0 or below: add one load_step from assets/exercises.js.
avg RPE 7.1 to 8.0: hold the load and add a rep, unless every set was already at the same load and at the top of the prescribed rep range, which earns the load step instead.
avg RPE 8.1 to 9.0: repeat the same load and clean up execution.
avg RPE above 9.0: hold, or back off five percent.
Bodyweight and timed work progresses on reps or seconds, never load.
Dumbbell loads are per hand, so one load_step of 5 is one size up on one bell.
Any of the above is overridden when the session note reports pain or a form breakdown. Load does not advance on a pattern he cannot yet brace.
progression.note: Fifth week with nothing to progress against, so every load carries forward. Prescriptions remain keyed to the last session each exercise actually appeared in: 09-16 for the Wednesday lifts, 09-11 for the Friday lifts, 09-09 for the lat pulldown. The 09-16 lat pulldown numbers are ignored on purpose, because that was the rotating-handle substitute machine he will not use again. Three steps are still owed and still unearned until a session lands: incline dumbbell press to 35 per hand, triceps pushdown 12 reps across at 35, walking lunge three full sets at 30 per hand. workout.html does not know the rep-range ceiling, so its on-page suggestion can read 'chase a rep' where the program names a heavier load. The program's named load wins.

sessions.title: Pull & Legs
sessions.focus: Anchor is the lat pulldown. Three sets of your favorite lift is the whole session; the leg press is a bonus if you are still there. Bolted onto the Tuesday walk.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.cue: The anchor. Standard wide bar, not the rotating-handle machine. 100 for 10 across on 09-09, so hold 100 and chase 12 before the load moves.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cue: Bonus, and the only leg work left in the week. Still no history after five weeks of carrying it. Pick a load you can finish ten clean reps with and write the number down. Stop before your hips curl off the pad.

sessions.title: Press, Glutes & Brace
sessions.focus: Anchor is the overhead press, the only lift in the week with a clean recent number. Glute bridge and bird dog behind it are floor work, no setup, both anti-lordosis.

exercises.name: Overhead dumbbell press
exercises.cue: The anchor. 30 per hand, same as 09-16, where the third set dropped to 25 at RPE 9. Three clean sets at 30 is the whole job. Per hand, not the pair.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cue: Replaces the hip thrust, which was programmed five weeks and never run. Same movement off the floor, nothing to set up. Stop at a straight line from knee to shoulder, ribs down, do not arch past it.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.cue: Easier to hold a flat back than the dead bug, which fell apart by set three on 09-16. Hips square, slow beats far. Finish with the couch stretch and log it as a cool-down, because no hip flexor work has shown up in any session yet.

sessions.title: Chest & Row
sessions.focus: Anchor is the incline press, which is owed a load step from 09-11. One row after it and the day is done. Fifteen minutes full out.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.cue: The anchor. 30 per hand for 10 across at Hard on 09-11 earned the step and it is still owed five weeks later. Go to 35 per hand, bench at 30 degrees.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable row
exercises.cue: The week's only horizontal pull. One arm at a time, single handle. You ran it two-handed on 09-11 and the load went unrecorded. Let the shoulder blade travel forward, then pull, and write the number down.

optional_addins.title: Hips & Posture
optional_addins.focus: Direct work on the lordosis: lengthen the hip flexors, get the glutes doing their job, brace without arching. The dead bug lost its brace on 09-16, and this is why.
optional_addins.when: Any off day, Monday included. 10 minutes, no equipment, doable at home. The one that actually moves the lordosis.

exercises.name: Couch stretch
exercises.cue: Squeeze the back glute to tuck the pelvis. That tuck is the stretch.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cue: Stop at a straight line. Do not arch past it.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cue: If the low back lifts, keep your heels sliding on the floor instead of hovering. Range is negotiable, the flat back is not.

optional_addins.title: Arms, Shoulders & Calves
optional_addins.focus: Low-stakes volume for arms, delts and calves. Nothing here taxes recovery, so skip it guilt-free. This is where the triceps pushdown and reverse pec deck live, off the critical path.
optional_addins.when: Saturday flex day, or bolted onto the end of any session that felt short. 20 minutes.

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise
exercises.cue: Lead with the elbow, stop at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.cue: Elbows at your sides. No swinging from the hips.

exercises.name: Triceps pushdown
exercises.cue: Parked at 35 for two sessions running. Stay at 35 and get 12 on all three sets, then it moves to 40.

exercises.name: Reverse pec deck
exercises.cue: The rear-delt slot. Elbows soft, light enough that nothing leans back.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top, and record the load.
